name: Mediavine Revenue Reports
description: Automates per-period Mediavine revenue export via pooled, proxied Playwright. Logs into the Mediavine reporting dashboard, pulls per-URL revenue rows for each requested period, and POSTs them back to a receiver (e.g. extrachill-analytics) via an HMAC-signed callback.

inputs.description: List of {period, period_start, period_end} objects to iterate, each YYYY-MM-DD. Takes precedence over period_start/period_end. Example: [{"period":"2022","period_start":"2022-01-01","period_end":"2022-12-31"}]. Use this for a multi-bucket backfill (e.g. yearly 2022-2026).
Start of a single reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD). Used when `periods` is not supplied. Paired with period_end.
End of a single reporting period (YYYY-MM-DD). Used when `periods` is not supplied. Paired with period_start.
Optional label for the single-period case (e.g. "2023-09"). Defaults to "<period_start>..<period_end>".
Which Mediavine report to pull. Currently only "pages" (per-URL revenue) is implemented.

HTTPS URL the module POSTs the completed revenue rows to. Body is JSON: {job_id, report_type, periods:[{period, rows:[...]}], status}. Best-effort: failures are logged but never propagate to the job result. When set with callback_secret, the request carries an Authorization: Bearer header signed with HMAC-SHA256.
Shared HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign the callback request. Matches the sweatpants core signed-token format so receivers validate with the same verifier (e.g. wp_native_auth_verify_external_token).
Opaque issuer string included as the `iss` claim in the signed callback token.
Subject claim (`sub`) in the signed callback token — typically the receiving WordPress user_id who submitted the job.

settings.description: Mediavine reporting dashboard login email. Stays on sweatpants — never sent to the WP side.
Mediavine reporting dashboard login password. Stays on sweatpants — never sent to the WP side.
